audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Kayle levels 2 and 3 and only 'Skill' at level 1 — the exact inverse of what the same page's own whys say, and of the packet chart (Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle). Level 6 was 'Skill' despite Divine Judgment blanking the all-in.
audit.why: Melee-form Kayle has no attack-speed steroid, no waveclear and no escape until 6; Lucian's Lightslinger double-shot wins levels 1-2 outright. The mirror (kayle__lucian) already set rows 0-1 to Lucian, row 2 to Skill and row 4 to Kayle.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle in both layers as matched pairs, matching the mirror exactly, with ratings re-scaled to 7/8/5/5/2/3/2.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] still described level 6 as Lucian's ult spike ('lane-clear and execute chip') on the level where Kayle's ult takes the lane.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s and makes her untargetable-invulnerable through the entire Culling channel — the single largest swing in the matchup.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Divine Judgment, its 160s rank-1 cooldown and what it blanks; the interactions row carries the same numbers.
sources: enemyKit Kayle R cd 160/120/80, untargetable flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that this matchup never names a single Kayle ability, and there is zero sequencing advice. Both flagged missing interactions (Celestial Blessing sustain, Starfire Spellblade auto reset) were absent.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing (W) heals on a flat 15s cooldown regardless of rank, so extended trades need Grievous Wounds. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto-attack reset on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s — the wind-up, not the cast, is the step-back cue. Radiant Blast (Q) is 900 range and shreds resistances.
audit.corrected: Real names and numbers written into report[5].t, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Melee-form Kayle has no mark and no steroid — Q through the wave on her last-hits and weave doubletaps on each step-up.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: E online and Q + Lightslinger lands: a pre-stats Kayle has no waveclear and no bail. Punish hard.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Full kit, but she farms under tower and XP-share keeps her level close — even, so trade only on her step-ups.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Divine Judgment goes invulnerable through your whole Culling channel — a 160s ult that blanks the all-in.

edits.before: Track Kayle’s Divine Judgment (Invuln): Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — bait it, then kill. Celestial Blessing heals on 15s; Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto reset, wind-up first.

edits.before: Kayle whiffs Divine Judgment (Invuln) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Buy Executioner's early — Celestial Blessing heals her back every 15s.

edits.before: That is Kayle’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Radiant Blast reaches 900 and shreds resists — you pay more to close than you get.
